name: Final Embrace Master
body:
General | Combat Stamina

Final Embrace Master (Combat)
Source Ultimate Combat pg. 102
Few creatures can survive the crushing horror of your Final Embrace.

Prerequisites: Str 17, Int 3; naga, serpentfolk, or creature that has the constrict special attack; Final Embrace; Final Embrace Horror; base attack bonus +9.

Benefit: Double the number of damage dice for your constrict special attack.
Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
Source Pathfinder Unchained pg. 119
Each time you constrict, you can spend 5 stamina points to triple the damage dice of your constrict ability instead of doubling them.
